**Finding: deviation (WARRANTY)** — submitted.

- **What the document says:** § 5.1 warrants only that IBM will perform Services "using reasonable care and skill" with qualified personnel, plus a corporate-authority rep and a covenant to comply with laws applicable to IBM's business. § 5.2 makes those the exclusive warranties, and § 5.4(c) provides all Materials "AS IS."
- **Why it fails the fallback:** no conformance warranty for Materials/Services output, no warranty duration, and no remedy (re-performance, repair, replacement or refund) — and the "AS IS" disclaimer swallows any residual protection for deliverables.
- **Redline (validated ok:true):** new § 5.1(c) 90-day conformance + no-malicious-code warranty for Materials; a remedy sentence after the compliance covenant (IBM's option: re-performance, repair/replacement, or refund of charges paid); and "EXCEPT AS EXPRESSLY WARRANTED IN SECTION 5.1" carve-out at the front of § 5.4(c). The existing care-and-skill language already meets the professional/workmanlike element and was left untouched.
